# Scenix v1.9.1 — Animato no_std Bridge Fix

Scenix `1.9.1` is a dependency patch release. It picks up
[Animato `1.7.3`](https://github.com/AarambhDevHub/animato/pull/56), whose
facade now declares `#![cfg_attr(not(feature = "std"), no_std)]`, closing
[scenix issue #21](https://github.com/AarambhDevHub/scenix/issues/21):
enabling the `animato` feature with `std` disabled no longer forces the
standard library into the build, so bridged animation works on bare-metal
and other `no_std` targets. No public scenix API changes.

## Highlights

- `animato` bridge dependency `1.7.2` → `1.7.3`:
  - The Animato facade (`animato`) is now `no_std`-capable and forwards the
    facade's core-only, `tween`, `spring`, `physics`, and `color` feature
    combinations to bare metal. `scenix-animato` with the `animato` facade
    feature compiles for `no_std`-only targets.
  - Upstream `timeline` and `path` facade features remain `std`-gated in
    Animato itself (their dependency trees still enable `animato-core/std`)
    — pre-existing behavior, unchanged in this release.
- Verified bare metal: `cargo check -p scenix-animato --no-default-features
  --target thumbv7m-none-eabi` passes; the same check previously failed with
  `E0463` and `cannot find attribute derive` errors once `animato` was
  enabled.
- crates.io note: published scenix `1.9.0` already resolved Animato
  `^1.7.2` → `1.7.3` (semver-compatible), so the fix reaches downstream
  users automatically. v1.9.1 makes the workspace pin explicit.
- Accurately updated `XR_VERSION`, `AUDIO_VERSION`, and
  `PHYSICS_VERSION` markers to `1.9.1`, and refreshed the Animato version
  references in the README, ARCHITECTURE, animation concepts, and FAQ docs
  to the `1.7.3` bridge target.

## Upgrade

Nothing to do: depend on `scenix`/`scenix-animato` as before. Cargo
resolution pulls Animato `1.7.3` for any `scenix = "1.9"` consumer.
